Pakistan Threatens India Over Indus Water Treaty

Pakistan has threatened to cut off water supplies to India under the Indus Water Treaty, which is a key agreement governing the sharing of water resources between the two countries. The treaty was signed in 1960 and has been the subject of controversy over the years. Pakistan's Minister of Foreign Affairs, Shah Mehmood Qureshi, has threatened to take action if India does not comply with the treaty. This threat has raised concerns about the potential impact on India's water supply and the stability of the region.
